_comment: The noise band is drawn as a picture of the receiver grid (raster), coloured in 5 dB bands after ISO 1996-2 / DIN 45682. Colours are applied by the engine (noise::band_colour); this layer sets how the picture is shown. The difference map between two scenarios (step N3) is coloured by the change in dB: `difference` gives each class's lower edge (null: no lower edge) and colour (null: not drawn).
